Key Findings

  1. 37 project folders spanning May 2025 to March 2026. 10 months of continuous documentation.
  2. Memorial Tower is the saga. 9 separate shoots (Aug 2025 - Feb 2026). Hundreds of cinema clips, drone footage, audio interviews, 400+ photos. This is a mini-documentary waiting to happen.
  3. Din Tai Fung has the most total footage. 3 shoots, 500+ files across all cameras, plus a finished vertical export. Fashion Square location = high-profile.
  4. 14 projects have DJI Mic / lav audio. These have interview or talking-head potential. Most valuable for authority content.
  5. 25+ projects have drone footage. Aerial coverage is the norm, not the exception. This is a differentiator.
  6. Primrose and Gilmore are pre-organized. Footage already sorted into aerial/b-roll/talking-shots. Ready for edit.
  7. High-profile client names available: Apple, Ritz Carlton, Tiffany's, INEOS Grenadier, Roka Akor, Din Tai Fung, Abrazo Healthcare, Banner Health. These are credibility bombs.
  8. 446 photos from Refined Gardens alone. Carousel and before/after content for days.
  9. Only 1 finished export found (DinTAI Dining Update Vertical.mov). Everything else is raw. Massive untapped potential.
  10. 4 Adobe Stock music tracks + 14 ElevenLabs VO files ready to use.

CONTENT BRIEFS: VIDEO FORMAT

Every 15-20 second Remotion animation follows this structure:

[0-2s]   HOOK TEXT (Barlow Condensed 800, red highlight word, navy overlay on footage)
[2-5s]   ESTABLISHING SHOT (drone aerial or wide ground shot, location bar overlay)
[5-10s]  THE WORK (2-3 b-roll cuts: equipment, crew, detail shots, text overlay stats)
[10-15s] THE PAYOFF (finished result, before/after, or scale reveal)
[15-18s] CTA END CARD (Ambition logo, phone, website, ROC#)

Overlays used (from Steffen's template spec):

  • Section 2.1: Hook Text (first 2 seconds)
  • Section 1.2: Location/Project Name Overlay (on establishing shots)
  • Section 2.2: Fact/Stat Callout (mid-video)
  • Section 1.5: Equipment/System Callout Labels (on detail shots)
  • Section 2.5: CTA End Card (last 3 seconds)

Music: Adobe Stock tracks from AUDIO BG folder. Rotate between:

  • "Street Art" (Main) for project spotlights
  • "Grinding" for equipment/industrial content
  • "Move It Now" for crew/energy content
  • "Street Style" for behind-the-scenes

Voice: ElevenLabs Ambition voice (ID: WkvyyiDC9ciaSfbQ8bxp) for stat callouts and hooks. Keep VO minimal (1-2 sentences max per video).

CONTENT BRIEFS: LINKEDIN POST FORMAT

Each LinkedIn post follows this structure:

  • Hook line (stops the scroll, specific, not generic)
  • Body (3-5 short paragraphs, 100-130 words total)
  • Soft CTA (website link or phone number, no hard sell)
  • Hashtags (5-7, core set + topic-specific)
  • Photo suggestion (real photo from archive, never stock)

Voice: Confident, direct, knowledgeable. Sounds like a crew lead, not a marketing agency. No em dashes. No exclamation points. See brand guidelines for full voice spec.

PRODUCTION PIPELINE

Each video piece flows through:

  1. Alex writes the brief (title, hook, footage source, overlays, text content)
  2. Steffen builds the Remotion animation (using brand templates + footage clips)
  3. Cleo cuts the raw footage clips to the specified timestamps
  4. Elmo QAs the output (brand compliance, overlay legibility, platform specs)
  5. Tony/Ash posts to platforms (or Postiz when live)

Estimated production time per video: 30-45 min (after templates are built) Estimated production time per LinkedIn post: 15 min (Alex writes, Patrik/Ash approves)

RECURRING CONTENT SERIES (Beyond 30 Days)

Once the first month is running, layer in these recurring series:

"Project Update" Series

Use Memorial Tower's 9 shoots to create a multi-part update series. Each installment covers one shoot date. 9 episodes minimum. Post every other week.

"The Equipment" Series

Weekly equipment spotlight. Close-up footage exists in nearly every project. Topics: rooftop units, chillers, VRV systems, crane operations, insulation, ductwork, refrigeration lines.

"Location Showcase" Series

Use LOCATION VIDEO and LOCATION PHOTOS folders. 7 locations documented. Each gets a "here's what we built" post with drone footage.

"Phoenix Heat" Seasonal Series

When summer approaches (April+), pivot to emergency response and heat-related content. Abrazo footage is the anchor. Ramp to 2-3 heat-themed posts per week May-September.

"Talking Heads" Series

Primrose (5 clips), Crown (talking shots), Gilmore (talking shots), Memorial Tower (talking shots across multiple shoots). Interview/testimonial content. Requires audio sync with DJI Mic files.

BUDGET IMPACT

This plan costs $0 in new footage. Everything comes from existing archive.

  • Retainer justification: consistent 7x/week posting justifies the $2k/month rate and supports the increase to $3.5k/month
  • Production time: ~4 hours/week for videos (Steffen + Cleo) + ~1 hour/week for LinkedIn posts (Alex)
  • The content library has enough footage for 3-6 months of daily posting without repeating

This plan mines 10 months of footage that got 1 post per project. Time to turn 37 folders into 200+ pieces of content.
